About this Event

Calling all Desi Girls… it’s your time to SHINE! 🪔✨💃🏽
Get your prettiest desi fits ready for an afternoon of dancing, sparkle & festive vibes! 💖

Diwali Edition: Dance workshop to "Desi Girl" 
Come step into your main character energy, all levels are welcome!

Song: Desi Girl
Dance Style: Bolly Femme
Date and Time: Sunday, November 15th, 2 PM - 3:30 PM Pacific Time (PST)

Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned dancer, this workshop is perfect for anyone looking to have fun and learn some new moves.

Please note: Kindly come 5 minutes before class time, so we can start on time
